name: obs-vllm-scheduler-preemption
notes: _preempt_request(): sets request.num_computed_tokens = 0, clears spec_token_ids, marks output stale, increments request.num_preemptions, records EngineCoreEventType.PREEMPTED, and prepends the request back to the waiting queue. get_kv_cache_usage() delegates to kv_cache_manager.usage -> block_pool.get_usage().
